info.description: SIH26265 prototype. Fictional institutions; labelled simulated bank data. No payment execution.

post.description: Administrators move a case between officers; an assigned officer may hand their own case back.
Vigilance closes an escalation once every suspicious finding on the case has been resolved.

The officer's formal sign-off. Refused until the bank has confirmed, the receipt is checked,
every review task is resolved and no suspicion above the limit remains uncleared by Vigilance.

get.description: Headline results of the latest synthetic-corpus evaluation (python -m evaluation).
Results by kind of case, signal precision, and every miss and false alarm from the latest evaluation.

post.description: What a policy would do to every open case, computed without storing anything.
Check (default) or import existing deposit records from CSV. Only rows without problems are imported.
